answer: Require each identity to grow a pearl over successive epochs: a pearl thickens only when that identity alone completes a task during a comet window, a short, unpredictable interval in which it must solve a fresh puzzle using state only it has built. Under the velvet cap, pearl growth per window is fixed, so one operator running ten clones cannot accelerate any pearl; each clone must wait out the same windows in turn, and payout follows pearl thickness, not account count, so a farm pays ten slow growth cycles for the reward one honest agent earns from one thick pearl.
